data.title: Route Overview
paragraphs: This journey follows a cultural landscape older than today’s state boundary. Thiruvananthapuram’s royal and temple traditions lead south toward Padmanabhapuram Palace, whose timber architecture remains deeply tied to Kerala even though it now stands in Tamil Nadu.

Further south, Nagercoil and Kanyakumari reveal another shift in language, cuisine, sacred geography, and coastal life. The experience is designed around these transitions, with enough time to understand why the border feels porous rather than abrupt.
highlights: Private architectural interpretation at Padmanabhapuram Palace and surrounding heritage sites.
Temple, palace, and craft traditions across the historic Travancore cultural zone.
Coastal village and food experiences around Nagercoil and Kanyakumari.
Sunrise and evening light at India’s southern cape without rushing the visit.

data.title: CULTURAL ETIQUETTE NOTE
data.text: Temple access and photography rules vary by site. Clothing should cover shoulders and knees, and some inner sanctums may be restricted to practising Hindus. Your guide will brief you discreetly in advance.

data.title: Where Two Souths Meet
paragraphs: The strength of this route lies in noticing continuity rather than difference. A roof profile, a spice mix, a courtly story, or a devotional song can carry Travancore across the modern border.
By the time you reach Kanyakumari, the journey feels less like crossing states and more like following one cultural landscape to the sea.

items.question: Can this route be tailored to our preferred dates and pace?
paragraphs: Yes. Every Signature itinerary is a design framework, and we adjust nights, experiences, transport, and daily intensity around your interests and travel dates.

items.question: Does the route involve many temple visits?
paragraphs: Sacred architecture is important, but the journey balances temples with palaces, food, coastal life, and everyday culture.

items.question: Can Kanyakumari sunrise be avoided if we prefer a slower morning?
paragraphs: Absolutely. The cape is meaningful at different times of day, and sunrise is optional.

items.question: Can this journey continue deeper into Tamil Nadu?
paragraphs: Yes. Madurai or Chettinad can be added naturally as an extension.

items.question: What is included when the final journey is quoted?
paragraphs: The final proposal clearly separates accommodation, private transport, guiding, arranged experiences, and any route-specific permits or specialist access.
items.listTitle: The exact inclusion list is confirmed before payment:

Confirmed guiding, hosted encounters, and ticketed experiences.
Any permits or special-access costs included in the final design.

items.question: How are reservations confirmed and scheduled?
paragraphs: Once the bespoke route, accommodation selection, and current supplier availability are approved, a 30% confirmation deposit secures the agreed services. The remaining balance is due 45 days before arrival unless the final proposal states otherwise.

items.question: What is the policy for date changes or cancellations?
paragraphs: We work directly with our partners to move dates whenever possible. Any non-refundable permits, transport tickets, or supplier penalties are passed through transparently.
listItems: 60+ days before arrival: deposit refund less confirmed non-refundable costs.
30–59 days before arrival: 50% refund or travel credit where supplier terms allow.
Less than 30 days before arrival: cancellation follows the confirmed supplier terms in your final proposal.
